newsitem.title: USA: Elizabeth Taylor, ex-husband, settle divorce terms.
newsitem.headline: Elizabeth Taylor, ex-husband, settle divorce terms.

text.p: Elizabeth Taylor and her former husband, Larry Fortensky, have settled the terms of their divorce amicably, the 65-year-old movie star's lawyer announced on Monday.

"Ms. Taylor and Mr. Fortensky have come to a resolution of all claims in the matter of their divorce. Ms. Taylor is pleased that an amicable agreement has been reached and wishes great happiness for Mr. Fortensky," attorney Arlene Colman-Schwimmer said in a statement.
She said the couple, who married in 1991 and were divorced last year, remained friends and have spoken since Taylor's brain surgery last month, in which a benign tumour was removed.

The terms of the agreement were not disclosed. Several court hearings on the matter had been scheduled over the past few months but were repeatedly postponed while the couple tried to sort out their differences privately without having to air them in public.

Taylor, who started off as a child actress and rose to become one of world's hottest movie stars, met Fortensky in 1988 while both were being treated for alcoholism at the Betty Ford Centre outside Palm Springs, California.

Fortensky, a construction worker and 20 years younger than Taylor, was constantly at her bedside when she was admitted to a hospital and nearly died of viral pneumonia in April 1990. After her recovery, the romance flourished.

When they married it was Fortensky's third wedding and Taylor's seventh. She married hotel heir Nick Hilton in 1950, British actor Michael Wilding in 1952, film producer Mike Todd in 1956, singer Eddie Fisher in 1959, Richard Burton in 1964 and again in 1975 and Republican Sen. John Warner in 1967. She was widowed when Todd died in an air crash in 1958.
